So the process ran for about 51 minutes before dying during Task 3. The failure reason mentions "process dead 5× with no sentinel/W&B", which suggests the process was killed or crashed. Given the strong performance metrics throughout, I'm wondering if this was an out-of-memory issue or something else terminating the process on GPU 1 where the model was running.

Looking at the timing, the OpenVLA attention experiment with k=0.95 was already running on GPU 1 when the pi05 baseline started at 12:55. The memory usage adds up to over 26GB combined, which exceeds the 24GB capacity, explaining why the process got killed. So my new submission is configured to use GPU 0 and will wait until it has less than 1GB of memory in use before starting, which should prevent this kind of collision. I need to reset the experiment status from DONE/failed back to a runnable state and update the registry with the new configuration. The output file shouldn't conflict since I've already verified it doesn't exist yet.
